samples_reviewed.question_text: A class started at 9:15 a.m. and ended at 9:35 a.m. How many minutes did it last?
hints: Start at 9:15 a.m. and count on by 5 minutes until you reach 9:35 a.m.
From 9:15 a.m. to 9:35 a.m. is 20 minutes.

samples_reviewed.question_text: Look at the bus timetable. According to the timetable, how many minutes is the travel time for Bus 1?

Count on from the start time to the end time: that is 30 minutes.

samples_reviewed.question_text: A school sports meet begins on Thursday and finishes on Saturday of the same week. How many days does the school sports meet run?
